title: Add task JSON contract canonicalization and compatibility guardrails
description:
Problem: task records currently exist in mixed JSON contract variants (PascalCase and camelCase root properties). Runtime deserialization is tolerant, but tooling and future schema/migration workflows can drift or break without explicit canonicalization policy.

Desired outcome: define one canonical persisted task contract and enforce compatibility through tests, linting, and migration-safe normalization strategy.

Scope:
- In scope: contract policy decision, optional one-time migration helper, read-path compatibility tests for legacy records, write-path canonical output checks, and guardrail lint command.
- Out of scope: redesigning task business semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Canonical task JSON format is documented and used for all newly written files.
- Legacy files remain readable or have a controlled migration path with rollback guidance.
- CI/local checks detect non-canonical new task artifacts.

Validation:
- Add tests proving both legacy and canonical records deserialize correctly.
- Add at least one negative test proving lint catches non-canonical output in newly generated artifacts.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from continued audit finding C-006 on task contract drift (PascalCase and camelCase coexistence).
